clips.title: The story
paras: You help Wizzlecrank flee the Venture Company drill site at the Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens. Trapped in a stolen prototype shredder, the goblin pilot needs protection from company mercenaries as he climbs from the industrial pit. Afterward, you report to his contact, Sputtervalve, in Ratchet.

Wizzlecrank struggles to control the stolen shredder at the Sludge Fen. He has lit the prototype deep inside the Venture Company drill site, but knows little of its levers and switches. The heavy machine lurches across the muddy quarry floor, and its erratic driving and roaring joints alert nearby laborers and armed guards. A stealthy escape becomes a running battle up the excavation pit’s western ramp.

The Venture Company sends mercenaries to stop the stolen prototype. As the machine claws up the slope toward open ground, squads move to intercept and disable it. The shredder lashes out, but cannot withstand their sabotage without your protection. It clears the rim and staggers from the main drilling depression, though the machine soon suffers a critical failure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... My time's running out! I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.
Oh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
